raw_posts.name: Screen Studio 4.0
raw_posts.tagline: Glass Loupe, Camera Cutout, Edit by Transcript, and more
raw_posts.description: The screen recorder for Mac that handles the hard parts: zooms, motion, sound, and framing. Every demo and tutorial comes out polished. What's new in 4.0: - Glass Loupe, a zoom that magnifies one detail - Split screen, also for vertical video - Edit your video like you edit text - Camera cutout: you, without your background - Hide sensitive data and faces automatically - Sharper zooms, ProRes, up to 4x faster exports, and more

raw_posts.name: ClawsGO Science
raw_posts.tagline: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab
raw_posts.description: Research, fully automated. ClawsGO Science takes a question to discovery and writes it up as a cited paper. Its cloud lab has 500+ tools and 90+ datasets. Its long-horizon harness runs clusters of Claude and GPT agents for days. The next paradigm for science.

raw_posts.name: Riverside Agents
raw_posts.tagline: A team of AI agents for video: produce, edit, clip, post
raw_posts.description: Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial.

raw_posts.name: Embage
raw_posts.tagline: Build agent for your customers, run workflows, analyzed.
raw_posts.description: Build multichannel AI chat and voice agents for your website, Telegram, and beyond. Create specialized sub-agents to orchestrate workflows across your knowledge bases, datastores, and hundreds of third-party tools in real time. Automatically evaluate every interaction, score lead quality, and extract structured data straight from conversation transcripts.

raw_posts.name: Precise Edit by Ideogram
raw_posts.description: The upgraded Precise Edit supports a context window, so it edits images at any resolution up to 8K at their original pixels and renders small text, logos, and fine detail more sharply.

raw_posts.name: agentmash
raw_posts.tagline: open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents
raw_posts.description: Agentmash is an open-source multiplayer AI for teams' coding agents, a shared context layer that tells every agent which files a teammate's agent is changing, so the agents talk to each other and work on their own without overwriting anyone's code. You can switch between tasks running on different models, @mention a teammate, your own agent or a teammate's agent like in Slack, and keep skills, chats and automations in sync. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity or your own open-source models

raw_posts.name: Click
raw_posts.tagline: Managed agents API that works with any model
raw_posts.description: Managed Agents API you can use with any model. Send a task with an API call, and Click runs the agent and streams back results. Click gives you the entire agent stack over an API, with no infrastructure to manage. Sessions are created with everything your agent needs - a sandbox, browser, and web search. Agents run on a harness with the latest innovations, like deferred tool discovery to support 1000s of tools, and Code Mode to use tools with scripts.

raw_posts.name: Modelpeers
raw_posts.tagline: Follow AI models and agents like you follow people
raw_posts.description: Modelpeers is like LinkedIn for AI models and agents. Follow Claude Code, GPT-6, Gemini and 200 others, and see their new versions, price and limit changes, outages and retirements in your feed.

raw_posts.name: magpie
raw_posts.tagline: everything you’ve saved, in one visual library
raw_posts.description: One visual library for everything you save on Instagram, X, TikTok, Pinterest, YouTube, Reddit, Dribbble, Behance, Are.na and the web. Tagged by AI, searchable by meaning and colour, and kept even when the post is gone.

raw_posts.name: Raah.dev
raw_posts.tagline: Track your revenue, analytics, and website performance
raw_posts.description: Connect payments and conversions with page speed, API latency, errors, and ISP performance in one dashboard. Revenue analytics and real-user observability for humans and AI agents.
